name: Girisopam
summary: Girisopam (GYKI-51189, EGIS-5810) is a drug which is a 2,3-benzodiazepine derivative related to tofisopam and zometapine. It has a selective anxiolytic action with no sedative, anticonvulsant or muscle relaxant effects.

pharmacology.text: It has a selective anxiolytic action with no sedative, anticonvulsant or muscle relaxant effects.

uses.en: It was studied as an anxiety medicine but was never marketed. It is known only from research.
uses.zh: 它曾被研究作為抗焦慮藥，但從未上市，只見於研究。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被研究作为抗焦虑药，但从未上市，只见于研究。

fact.en: Girisopam is a 2,3-benzodiazepine, a family developed in Hungary. Unlike ordinary benzodiazepines, these drugs do not bind the usual benzodiazepine site on GABAA receptors.
fact.zh: Girisopam 屬於在匈牙利開發的 2,3-苯二氮平類。與一般苯二氮平類不同，這類藥物不會結合 GABAA 受體上常見的苯二氮平結合位。
fact.zhHans: Girisopam 属于在匈牙利开发的 2,3-苯二氮平类。与一般苯二氮平类不同，这类药物不会结合 GABAA 受体上常见的苯二氮平结合位。
